title: Merge queue
description: A merged PR receives an atomic item-owned merge receipt and landing stamps before the holder is notified. Worker closeout still owns results and verification. A queue entry marked UNMERGEABLE stops the landing once GitHub decides its mergeability, even before GitHub removes it; while GitHub still reports mergeable as unknown, the landing stays pending and no notice goes out. An open PR whose merge state GitHub reports as unknown is also still pending: GitHub reports unknown while it recomputes, including mid-merge after it clears the queue entry and merge-when-ready. An open CLEAN PR with arming cleared and no queue entry is re-read once after three seconds before a stopped notice; a merge on that read receives the completion notice, while persistent absence still stops. yoke merge item enqueues a PR GitHub can queue now (CLEAN, HAS_HOOKS or UNSTABLE) with enqueuePullRequest and arms one still waiting on checks; both pass the lane head, and an already-queued refusal counts as entry. An armed ready PR may briefly lack its entry after checks pass. The observer directly requests enqueue at the unchanged head once per PR/head and re-reads: entry or merge succeeds even if GitHub won the race. A durable automatic re-entry receipt prevents a second mutation. A refusal without entry stops with GitHub's error; an accepted request without entry stops naming its receipt. Failed checks, failed trains, base conflicts and moved heads never auto-enqueue. The three-second confirmation applies only to unarmed CLEAN mid-merge reads. A conflicting entry's notice names rebase onto the base, verification, and governed merge re-entry. A mergeable entry needs no holder action: the landing observer re-enqueues the unchanged head by itself, and a hold would switch that recovery off. An ejected PR whose mergeability GitHub still reports unknown is re-read once: CONFLICTING hands back the rebase recovery, and a persistent unknown notice says GitHub is still computing mergeability and names that rebase recovery instead of promising re-enqueue; a later CONFLICTING read sends a fresh rebase notice. Queue CI evidence uses the merge gate's registered full command, falling back to quick. Missing executable commands stop close-out without an unchanged retry; recovery names yoke qa registered-command set. Source-observed; deployed proof is pending. Arming, disarming and dequeuing request Contents write and Pull requests write on installation tokens; an operator hold still requires bound user authority by policy.
